name: 2009 - 2010 Class Size - School-level Detail
description:
This dataset contains school-level class size information for New York City public schools during the 2009–2010 school year. Each row describes a group of classes at a particular school, identified by borough, community school district, school code, and school name, and broken down by grade, program type (general education, collaborative team teaching, special education, or gifted and talented), and—for middle and high school grades—core subject and course. For kindergarten through grade 9, rows may also indicate a service category such as 12:1:1 or 12:1 staffing arrangements.

The main measures are the number of classes, total student register, average class size, and the size of the smallest and largest classes in each group. A schoolwide pupil-teacher ratio is included for some schools, and a data source field indicates whether figures came from STARS or ATS. This dataset provides school-level class size detail for New York City public schools for the 2009–2010 school year, organized by borough, community school district, school, grade, program type, and subject or service category. It includes counts of classes, total student register, average, smallest, and largest class sizes, along with schoolwide pupil-teacher ratios and a data source field. Belonging to the education domain, the data supports analyses of class size variation across schools, districts, and grade levels; comparisons of core academic subjects versus specialized services; and research on resource allocation and pupil-teacher ratios. It could be used by researchers, policymakers, and school administrators to assess equity in class sizes, evaluate staffing patterns, and inform decisions
